raw_response:
My reasoning:

I am 70 years old and been farming these 18 mu for 50 years. I only finished primary school, so I do not read too many books — I follow what worked last year and what my neighbors do. My three sons and their wives work in the town factory, so at home it is mostly me and my old man, and we hire some day-workers during cotton picking and wheat harvest.

I split the land like this every year: cotton on about 10 mu (the sandy piece near the canal, good for cotton), and wheat-maize double-crop on the other 8 mu. That is how we always did it in Quzhou.

For cotton, I buy 2 bags of compound fertilizer (那个15-15-15的) per mu as base before ploughing, and then when the buds come I topdress with about half a bag of urea (尿素) per mu. That is how the village agro-shop老板 told us years ago and it works. Cotton drinks a lot, so I water 3 times from the well — once after planting, once at flowering, once at boll. Cotton has many bugs, 棉铃虫 and 蚜虫, so I spray many times, maybe 8 or 9 sprays in the summer, every 10 days or so. Last year I got about 250 斤 of seed cotton per mu... no wait, about 250 公斤 per mu of seed cotton, that is normal for us.

For winter wheat, I put 1 bag of compound per mu before sowing in October, and in spring when it turns green I broadcast about 15 公斤 urea per mu. I water 3 times — the winter water, the green-up water, and the filling water. Wheat does not get too many bugs here, I spray 2 times, once for 蚜虫 and once with the one-spray-three-defenses mix. I plough before sowing because that is proper. I get about 450 公斤 per mu usually.

For summer maize after the wheat, I do not plough, just rotary and seed directly — no time, the rain is coming. I use 1 bag compound at sowing and then side-dress about 20 公斤 urea at big trumpet stage. Water once or twice depending on rain. Spray 1 time for the borer. Get about 500 公斤 per mu.

I use improved seed from the shop for all three — the old varieties nobody sells anymore. I do not change my amounts. Fertilizer is expensive, yes, but if I put too little and the harvest is bad, that is much worse. Better to spend a few extra 块钱 on fertilizer.
